_comment: Claude Code needs no copying: .mcp.json at the repository root is this
server, committed, and every worktree gets it. This file is the
user-scoped equivalent (~/.claude.json) for connecting from outside the
repository -- that one cannot use a relative --directory, so the absolute
path has to be filled in.
Machine-specific settings (CRYPTO_KB_QDRANT_URL above all) belong in
kb/.env, which is gitignored. Values set here override it.
